item.testosteronedsc: A 100ml syringe containing an anabolic steroid in the form of testosterone. Makes you stronger over time but causes complications if overused.
item.ketaminedsc: A 100ml syringe containing Ketamine, a dissociative. Provides highly effective pain relief but causes altered perception and a disconnect from reality. The overdose label reads 60ml.
item.semaglutidedsc: A 100ml syringe containing semaglutide, an appetite suppressant. Stops hunger from decaying but causes sickness. The overdose label reads 75ml.
item.vigatrodipsindsc: A 100ml syringe containing vigatrodipsin, a thirst suppressant. Stops thirst from decaying but acts as a diuretic if you’re above 60 thirst, rapidly draining fluids.
item.clonidinedsc: A 100ml syringe containing clonidine, an alpha-2 agonist. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition and provides minor pain relief. Don’t combine with other drugs. Moderately effective but lowers blood pressure. The overdose label reads 30ml.
item.diazepamdsc: A 100ml syringe containing diazepam, a benzodiazepine. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition. Don't combine with other drugs. Moderately effective but highly addictive. The overdose label reads 80ml.
item.phenobarbitaldsc: A 100ml syringe containing phenobarbital, a barbiturate. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition. Don't combine with other drugs. Highly effective, but causes extreme complications if you take too much. The overdose label reads 70ml.
item.hydrochlorothiazidedsc: A small plastic bottle containing a handful of hydrochlorothiazide pills, a diuretic. Rapidly drains fluid from your body. Useful if you’re drowning in it, dangerous if you’re not.
item.diphenhydraminedsc: A blister pack of twelve 15mg diphenhydramine tablets, a sedative antihistamine. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition. Don’t combine with other drugs. Mildly effective at standard doses. In very large doses, highly effective but toxic. The overdose label reads 150mg.
item.clonidinebottledsc: A small plastic bottle containing eight 0.1mg clonidine pills, an alpha-2 agonist. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition and provides minor pain relief. Don’t combine with other drugs. Moderately effective but lowers blood pressure. The overdose label reads 0.3mg.
item.diazepambottledsc: A small plastic bottle containing eight 10mg diazepam pills, a benzodiazepine. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition. Don't combine with other drugs. Moderately effective but highly addictive. The overdose label reads 40mg.
item.phenobarbitalbottledsc: A small plastic bottle containing five 30mg phenobarbital pills, a barbiturate. Lets you sleep regardless of your physical condition. Don't combine with other drugs. Highly effective, but causes extreme complications if you take too much. The overdose label reads 70mg.
item.jointdsc: A small cardboard roach with rolling paper wrapped around it, full of cannabis. The tip features chemicals that remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.spliffdsc: A small cardboard roach with rolling paper wrapped around it, full of a mix of cannabis and tobacco. The tip features chemicals that remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.cigarettedsc: A standard cigarette with a shrivelling filter. The chemicals on the tip remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.cigardsc: A fancy-looking cigar with a visibly aged wrap. Provides more nicotine than a cigarette. The tip has a chemical that reminds you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.bluntdsc: A fancy-looking cigar with a green-tinted wrap. There’s cannabis inside it. Provides more nicotine than a cigarette and more cannabinoids than a joint. The tip features chemicals that remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.nicotinegumdsc: A small plastic container holding blue-tinged pieces of gum. Less intense than a cigarette, but more intense than a patch. Good for managing withdrawals, as it doesn't render you out of breath.
item.nicotinepatchesdsc: A small bag containing a number of sticky nicotine patches. Good for managing withdrawals, as it doesn't render you out of breath. Doesn't have much nicotine in it. Apply to the skin.
item.cigarettesdsc: A pack of cigarettes stored in a warning-riddled cardboard case. They advertise themselves as having chemicals in the tip that can ignite against a matchbox. You could probably do it with your claws.
item.illegalcigarettesdsc: A pack of cigarettes. The box is promoting tobacco as a healthy alternative to harder drugs. The chemicals on the tip remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.cannabiscigarettedsc: A standard cigarette with a shrivelling filter, only filled with cannabis instead of tobacco. The filter blocks a portion of the cannabinoids, leading to a lower overall dose compared to joints. The tip features chemicals that remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.tobaccojointdsc: A small cardboard roach with rolling paper wrapped around it, filled with tobacco. Delivers more tar due to the lack of a filter. The tip features chemicals that remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.emptyjointdsc: A small cardboard roach with rolling paper wrapped around it, only empty.
item.spincigarettedsc: A standard cigarette with a shrivelling filter, filled with a mix of cannabis and tobacco. The filter blocks a portion of the cannabinoids, leading to a lower total dose compared to joints. The tip features chemicals that remind you of matches. You could probably strike it with your claws.
item.emptycigarettedsc: A standard cigarette with a shrivelling filter, only empty.
item.tobaccodsc: A brown, dry herb, full of nicotine. Not very tasty, but it’ll give you a kick.
item.cannabisdsc: A green, sticky herb containing cannabinoids. Useless as a drug unless smoked, although you can eat it in an emergency.
item.spindsc: A yellow-green powder with dark spots. A mix of tobacco and cannabis, containing both nicotine and cannabinoids. The cannabis won't have any effect unless you smoke it, but eating spin will provide a small amount of nicotine and nutrients in an emergency.

moodle.adverseInteractionDesc: You've taken drugs that shouldn't be mixed. Health complications likely.
moodle.diuresisDesc: Fluid is rapidly draining from your body.
moodle.sedatedDesc: Under the influence of sedatives. You feel your energy shrinking by the minute. Any circumstance seems comfy when you're this tired.
moodle.antichollinergicActivityDesc: You've had a lot of antihistamines and are starting to feel the effects. Thirsty, with a racing heart and a warm feeling in your core.
moodle.antichollinergicToxicityDesc: You've overdosed on antihistamines. Burning up, with slurred speech. Your heart can't take much more of this.
moodle.antichollinergicCrisisDesc: You've severely overdosed on antihistamines. With severe hyperthermia and a heart on the brink of fibrillation, death is a real possibility.
moodle.mildSympatholyticToxicityDesc: You've had a large dose of an alpha-2 agonist and are starting to feel the effects. Lowered blood pressure and heart rate. You feel surprisingly calm.
moodle.sympatholyticToxicityDesc: You’ve overdosed on an alpha-2 agonist. Your lungs feel heavy, your body feels cold, and your heart has slowed dramatically. Everything feels less urgent now.
moodle.sympatholyticCrisisDesc: You've severely overdosed on an alpha-2 agonist. Lethal hypotension and lowered heart rate combined with hypothermia. Your lungs feel like dead weight, but for some reason, you aren't worried. Death imminent.
moodle.mildHypnoticToxicityDesc: You've had a large dose of a sedative-hypnotic drug and are starting to feel the effects. Your speech is slurred and your coordination is getting worse. Still alert.
moodle.hypnoticToxicityDesc: You've overdosed on a sedative-hypnotic drug. It’s getting harder to breathe, and your coordination has further degraded. Slightly confused, with a slower heart rate.
moodle.severeHypnoticToxicityDesc: You've severely overdosed on a sedative-hypnotic drug. Your lungs are failing, and so is your heart. Death imminent.
moodle.lethalBenzodiazepineWithdrawalDesc: Your body is failing to sustain itself without the benzodiazepines it became so reliant on. Your nervous system is in chaos and you’re severely suicidal. Brain damage imminent.
moodle.severeBenzodiazepineWithdrawlDesc: Your mind and body are struggling to regulate themselves without benzodiazepines. Experiencing panic attacks, confusion, muscle pain, and depression.
moodle.benzodiazepineWithdrawalDesc: Your body is desperate for another hit. Anxious and nauseous. Your mouth feels dry.
moodle.barbiturateToxicityDesc: You’ve minorly overdosed on barbiturates. Thirsty, with a lowered heart rate and moderate confusion. Your body feels heavy and cold.
moodle.severeBarbiturateToxicityDesc: You’ve overdosed on barbiturates. Lowered blood pressure, heart rate, respiration rate, and body temperature. Severe confusion. Death likely without rapid intervention.
moodle.horrificBarbiturateToxicityDesc: You’ve horrifically overdosed on barbiturates. Fatally low blood pressure, heart rate, and body temperature. Extreme thirst causes rapid dehydration. Your lungs are failing and you can barely move. Extremely confused. Death all but guaranteed.
moodle.cannabinoidIntoxicationDesc: Euphoric, calm, and feeling less pain. Your body tingles and feels slightly heavier than usual. You could really do for a bite.
moodle.horrificNicotineWithdrawalDesc: Your mind is crying out at the lack of nicotine, and your body follows. Experiencing tremors and a severe headache. You don't want any drug that isn't nicotine, and the longer you go without it, the more miserable you'll get. Can't sleep.
moodle.severeNicotineWithdrawalDesc: You're struggling to hold your mind together. Irritable, paranoid, and depressed. Can't sleep. You need another hit, right now.
moodle.nicotineWithdrawalDesc: Your body is desperate for another hit. Restless and tingly with a nasty headache.
moodle.nicotinatedDescNoTolerance: Energised and a little happier. Less hungry. It feels nice.
moodle.nicotinatedDescLowTolerance: Slightly less hungry with minor energy gain. Doesn't feel as good as it used to.
moodle.nicotinatedDescHighTolerance: No real effects, just tides over the withdrawals.
moodle.lethalSteroidAbuseDesc: You’ve been abusing steroids to the extreme. Your heart is ready to burst under its own pressure.
moodle.steroidAbuseDesc: You’ve been using steroids way too much. Greatly elevated heart rate and blood pressure. Your mood is highly volatile.
moodle.steroidOveruseDesc: You’ve been using steroids too much. Elevated heart rate and blood pressure. You feel anxious.
moodle.dissociatingDesc: Your brain is in a completely different place. Pain isn’t something you can understand anymore.
moodle.mildDissociativeToxicityDesc: You've had a large amount of dissociatives and are starting to feel the effects. Nauseous and experiencing involuntary movements. You feel like a passenger in your own body.
moodle.dissociativeToxicityDesc: You've overdosed on dissociatives. Your consciousness is fading while your blood pressure and heart rate rise. Your lungs feel slightly heavy.
moodle.severeDissociativeToxicityDesc: You've severely overdosed on dissociatives. Dangerously high heart rate and blood pressure along with respiratory depression. Coma and death possible.
moodle.trippingDesc: Reality distorted. You can’t interact with the world properly, but you feel so happy…
moodle.elsewhereDesc: You’re in an entirely different dimension.
moodle.breakthroughDesc: Any trace of the real world is absent from your mind. You feel at peace, content with the world.
moodle.rollingDesc: Everything feels amazing. You feel warm and euphoric in waves that come and go, and socialising is so much easier than ever before.
moodle.sympathomimeticActivityDesc: You've had too much entactogens and are starting to feel the effects. Your mouth is painfully dry, your heart is pounding, and you're sensitive to light.
moodle.sympathomimeticToxicityDesc: You've overdosed on entactogens. You're clumsy, and your heart rate and blood pressure are dangerously high.
moodle.sympathomimeticCrisisDesc: You've severely overdosed on entactogens. Your heart rate and blood pressure are through the roof. Stroke and death likely.

smokeWet: Gotta wait for it to dry off...
smokeWetCraving: Can't this thing dry any faster?
I shouldn't have got it wet...
Wish I could dry it off quicker.
smokeWetWithdrawal: Damnit, I need this, it's not dry enough...
I can't afford to wait for it to dry...
smokeWetNeed: No, no, dry off, dry off..!
Shit..! I need this, why is it soaked?!
DAMNIT! I NEED IT TO BE DRY!!
I can't wait any longer, I need this now, please dry quicker...
nicsmokeNoTolerance: Isn't this stuff bad for you..?
I think some of the smoke blew out of my nose.
How do people do this every day?
nicsmokeLowTolerance: Ohhh... I see why people like this!
I could get used to this.
This stuff is nicer than I thought.
nicsmokeHighTolerance: Don't know what I'd do without my fix.
I barely even feel the smoke anymore...
nicsupNoTolerance: They do say this is better than smoking...
Maybe I'll get used to it?
nicsupLowTolerance: Ohhh... I see why people like this!
I could get used to this.
This stuff is nicer than I thought.
nicsupHighTolerance: At least it's healthier than smoke...
That should hold off the withdrawals for a bit.
I wish I didn't need this.
I need to stop using this stuff...
Don't know what I'd do without my fix.
nicWithdrawal: I could really use a smoke...
nicotinatedEarly: Wow... this feels better than expected.
That weird feeling was definitely worth it.
nicotinatedMiddle: Oh... it's not as good as before.
Am I getting used to this..?
Maybe it was just a low quality batch?
Not what I expected, but it's still fun.
nicotinatedLate: This used to feel like something...
Am I really this used to it already..?
Doesn't even feel like I took anything...
I shouldn't have started using that crap...
I can feel it in my lungs now...
All that, just to feel normal again...

liquid.semaglutidedsc: An appetite suppressant. Stops hunger from decaying. Drinking not recommended.
liquid.vigatrodipsindsc: A thirst suppressant. Stops thirst from decaying. Drinking not recommended.
liquid.cbddsc: A cannabinoid in oil form. Reduces pain and anxiety.
liquid.thcdsc: A cannabinoid in oil form. Causes euphoria and makes you hunger.
liquid.testosteronedsc: An anabolic steroid. Makes you stronger over time. Less effective if drunk.
liquid.clonidinedsc: Potent sedative and alpha-2 agonist. Also lowers blood pressure and provides pain relief. The safe dose is extremely low. Consider diluting.
liquid.diazepamdsc: Potent benzodiazepine sedative. Hard to overdose on, but highly addictive.
liquid.phenobarbitaldsc: Highly potent barbiturate sedative. Much stronger than Diazepam.
liquid.ketaminedsc: Dissociative anaesthetic. Extremely effective at relieving pain.
